sections.en: Foundations of the Moon in Mars

summary.headline: Judgments of Lunar Foundations
summary.text: Astrological judgments for the Moon’s foundations in Capricorn, Aquarius, and Pisces, followed by Mars’s judgments in the Moon’s foundational positions from Aries through Leo. Decan and sign positions predict royal fortunes, weather, disease, military conditions, earthquakes, agriculture, and political conflict.
